title: Cords of Love
traveler_why: Wren is the Traveler who notices how love leads without pushing, and tonight Hosea shows the Lord drawing His people with bands of love instead of hard ropes. Sitting down near the new boy, sliding the good blue cushion over and waiting for him to come is exactly Wren’s kind of wondering, patient kindness.
traveler_about: Wren fits tonight because she notices how love leads without pushing. In Wren’s world today: a new boy at preschool would not come to circle time. Wren did not tug his sleeve. She sat down nearby, slid the good blue cushion over to him, and waited. He came. Just like Heavenly Father drew His people with bands of love, Wren learned that kindness invites better than pulling.
